evidence.quote: Search and select a chat to start.

evidence.note: Hidden behind the overlay, there is only a top search bar. There are no global navigation destinations.

structure.layout: Full-screen overlay: 4-column centered grid of user tiles (avatar, name, button) with a close X at top right, covering a two-pane messenger

aesthetics.typography: -apple-system / system sans stack (Helvetica/Arial fallback) for everything: usernames and buttons
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat: 16px regular usernames and 16px button labels. No headings, and very little hierarchy.

notes: Electron-style IGdm clone. The capture shows a 'following' overlay with no title: 26 accounts in a 4-column grid, each column 360px wide. Each tile is a 48px circular avatar (cartoon illustration, or a two-letter monogram in serif caps on a colored disc), a centered username, and a Bootstrap-like solid blue (#168bf9) 'Unfollow' button with 4px radius. The only other chrome is a thin gray X at top right. Behind it sits the messenger: a search bar, a conversation list with unread blue dots, an empty state with an Instagram logo, and the text 'Start a message'.
